impact.text: This traps the funds of the remaining liquidity providers, who are left with a depleted pool and are still subject to the now-restrictive withdrawal cap.

precondition_sources.text: The total supply of one of the market's synthetic tokens (aToken or zToken) is zero.
The attacker holds the entire remaining supply of the other synthetic token.

intent_sources.text: The swap(SYNTH -> BASE) function should always be subject to the redeem cap, without exception.
The full-redeem cap-bypass path should only be reachable when the user is redeeming the full supply of both aToken and zToken, preventing the 0 == 0 loophole.
